annotation.title_clean: CARICOM Declaration on Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.title_en: CARICOM Declaration on Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: CARICOM Implementation Agency for Crime and Security (IMPACS)
annotation.summary_en: Press release on the 6 September 2023 CARICOM Declaration on Autonomous Weapons Systems, adopted at a Port of Spain conference. It calls for an international legally binding instrument prohibiting and regulating autonomous weapons, addressing non-proliferation, diversion to non-state actors, and domestic security and law enforcement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Declaration calls for urgent pursuit of a legally binding international instrument with prohibitions and regulations on autonomous weapons
Instrument should address non-proliferation and diversion to non-state armed groups and terrorists
Highlights challenges to internal security, law enforcement and border security
Notes over 90 states and the UN Secretary-General back a treaty by 2026
Lack of human control raises IHL, human rights and accountability concerns
